p8_06_exact_match_discrepancy.legacy_scope: Evaluated only hard_constraints and needs_clarification, completely omitting soft_preferences.

p8_07_brand_failure_case.issue: Extracted Boeing as brand on an unserviceable out-of-catalog query.

soft_preferences_root_cause.finding: Product-class nouns (e.g. running shoes, wireless keyboard, dslr lens) were categorized as soft preferences because Schema v1.0.0 had no dedicated product_type field.

experiments_not_executed: E5-C (Multi-call API pipeline was intentionally rejected because single-call staged extraction E5-B surpassed all accuracy targets while eliminating double latency and double API cost)
